description.html: The Arcadia 12% UVB T8 fluorescent tube, 18W and 600mm long, delivers the strongest UVB radiation in the T8 series, made for desert reptile species exposed to extreme sun in the wild. UVB radiation is essential for vitamin D3 synthesis in the skin, which enables calcium absorption and proper bone development, preventing metabolic bone disease (MBD).

The 12% output suits the most demanding desert species, such as bearded dragons and uromastyx. The 600mm tube covers larger terrariums and is installed in a matching T8 fitting at the top. Replacement is recommended every 12 months, because UVB output gradually weakens even though the visible light stays the same.
